game.title: Atlanta Falcons at New Orleans Saints

lede: New Orleans Saints carries the stronger EdgeDesk offensive profile (#21 in EPA per play) and the better defensive rating with it, so the ratings point the same way on both sides of the ball.
EdgeDesk’s independent projection makes it New Orleans Saints -4.6 with a fair total of 42.4 — inside a touchdown, before any sportsbook number is consulted.

The widest measured matchup on the board is Atlanta Falcons pass offence vs New Orleans Saints pass defence, which sits −0.191 from the league mean once the two ratings are combined the way the model combines them.
The largest uncertainty is availability: NFL injury report — not loaded in this session.
